instruction: Add Firefox to the dock as a favorite.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding Firefox to the favorites dock. Initial setup creates favorites list ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']. After adding Firefox, the expected result should contain all 4 apps. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric which compares sets (order-independent).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GNOME favorite apps using appropriate gsettings command
Metric correctly parses the output string and compares as sets (order-independent verification)
Expected value correctly includes all 4 apps: original 3 plus firefox.desktop
Length check ensures exact count match, preventing extra/missing apps
Set comparison correctly verifies Firefox is added alongside existing apps
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement: Firefox must be present in favorites
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor code quality issue: metric uses eval() to parse the string output, which is a security anti-pattern. Consider using ast.literal_eval() instead for safer parsing, though functionally it works correctly in this controlled environment
